title: Compatibility and support for OTel SDKs
intro: The following table provides an overview of compatibility and support of EDOT SDKs with Elastic Agent versions:

sections.heading: EDOT SDKs vs Elastic Agent version
notes: This applies to all EDOT SDKs: EDOT .NET, EDOT Java, EDOT Node.js, EDOT PHP, EDOT Python, EDOT Android, EDOT iOS.
Refer to the [Elastic Agent compatibility table](https://www.elastic.co/docs/reference/opentelemetry/compatibility/collectors) for compatibility with Elastic Stack versions.
For the best experience, export data from EDOT SDKs using the [Elastic Agent](https://www.elastic.co/docs/reference/edot-collector).
Note: Ingesting data from EDOT SDKs through Elastic Agent into Elastic Stack versions 8.18 or higher is supported (Supported).

sections.heading: Support matrix for EDOT SDK ingestion
rows: Fully supported for Elastic Cloud Serverless and Elastic Cloud Hosted.
Telemetry might ingest but mapping, enrichment, and troubleshooting are not guaranteed.

sections.heading: Other SDK distributions
sections.text: OTel SDK distributions other than the ones listed above are technically compatible (Compatible) with Elastic but are not officially supported by Elastic (Supported).
notes: In the source page, 'Compatible' and 'Supported' link to [Nomenclature](https://www.elastic.co/docs/reference/opentelemetry/compatibility/nomenclature).
